pin_regs.reason: ot_qkd_ahub_die is the die composition: every hub port lands on a CLOSED leaf pin flop (core native pin form, tiles' own pin flops) or on a parent relay station (u_si / u_pi SI_RLY 1, u_sr SR_RLY 1, u_rxi / u_ryo, reset synchroniser u_rp); all on the one spine root ck

floorplan_note: KV-AHUB hp4 2026-10-17 re-plan (hp3 FAIL: GRT 11, setup -845, entry arrivals 11-2,424 ps): dataflow columns. Lanes g=0..3 at x 172.8 / 345.6 | 561.6 / 734.4 (21.6 um gaps, 64.8 um centre channel 496.8-561.6 under the si pins): pbst row y 86.4 right above its pi_data[g] S-face pins, 108 um sr crossbar channel (u_sr relays, pbst[g] -> all four pvlg, span 713 um -> 2 hops), pvlg row y 345.6, core row y 561.6: zh0 43.2 / zh1 216 | core 432 (S face over the pvlg row: pl_y / rz / ra) | zh2 648 / zh3 820.8; reciprocal leaf R0 at 907.2,302.4 beside pvlg3 under zh3 (u_rxi / u_ryo relays, <= ~400 um hops). Outputs N face over the core. One clock entry ck (S face centre beside the relay mass) -> one balanced spine (H-tree) to all 14 child clock pins + relays, leaf targets = routed boundary insertion (pbst 313 / zh 247 / recip 239 / core 213 / pvlg 193 ps). hp4c: rows +43.2 so the core N edge (712.8) leaves 0.47 of its GRT gcell free (518.4 row: 0.26 free -> pin-access overflow 70-89 at the core N face); outputs unconstrained on N.

job.purpose: KV-AHUB hp4: ot_qkd_ahub_die parent re-plan: one clock entry + spine H-tree over the 14 closed children, regional reset pipe, dataflow-column floorplan

structural_change: hp4 (KV-AHUB 10-17): hp3 gate FAIL (GRT ov 11; pre-route setup -845 = rst_n port -> pbst rst_n, reg->pbst ra -302 over ~915 um, u_sr -165; 21 clock entries with unbuffered entry wires: child pin arrivals 11-2,424 ps, slew up to 7.7 ns; ck_si 492/98.5). Structural: (1) ONE regional clock entry ck + balanced spine H-tree with child-insertion leaf targets over all 14 hard children and the relay flops (RTL define QKD_AHUB_ONE_CK, 0 cycles): the zero-relay core<->zh/pvlg/pbst hops fixed by the closed core's latency parameters are timed on one propagated tree instead of paying the per-entry die-skew reserve (150-210 setup / 100 hold); (2) regional reset ot_rst_pipe 14 regions x 3 stages (equal release edge for every child); (3) re-placed children in dataflow columns: lanes contiguous (crossbar span 1,080 -> 713 um), core over the pvlg row centre, worst unregistered core->child hop ~650 um (was ~915).
cycle_cost: +1 edge hub input -> output (SI_RLY 1, unchanged from hp3); reset release +5 edges after rst_n (no consumer counts from the port)
